messages:
Priya Rao: quick heads-up on NimbusPay onboarding — hit a couple of p95 latency spikes during 09:00-11:00 UTC this week. onboarding usage ramp looks healthy but token spend is ~22% above our forecast. customer mentioned renewal concerns if costs keep rising. proposing a proactive perf plan (quant swap canary + weighted routing + short enablement) to defuse risk and show savings. assigning @Marco for config recs.

Marco Diaz: saw the traces, thanks. quick plan:
- rollout q4 quant on the 13B prod variant as a 5% canary
- add weighted routing to prefer q4 variant when p95 < 250ms, fallback to 7B for heavy tails
- run the small eval set for semantic fidelity before 100% swap

Example routing policy (canary):
```json
{
  "policy": "latency_priority",
  "rules": [
    {"max_p95_ms": 250, "model": "redwood/llm-13b-v2-q4"},
    {"max_p95_ms": 500, "model": "redwood/llm-7b-v1"}
  ],
  "fallback": "redwood/llm-7b-v1"
}
```

Quick commands to run canary:
```bash
rictl deploy-quant --account nimbuspay --model redwood/llm-13b-v2 --quant q4_0 --canary 5%
rictl update-routing --account nimbuspay --policy-file ./nimbus-routing.json
```

Marco Diaz: expectation: ~15-25% token cost reduction for common short prompts, p95 latency should drop ~12-18ms on avg. quality risk: minimal on chat-short tasks, watch long-form generation.

Aisha Mbaye: good call. how do we present this to customer for renewal motion? need clear before/after metrics we can show in the renewal deck. can we guarantee no regression for their top-10 intents? :thinking_face:

Marco Diaz: we can run an AB eval on their top-10 intents (we already have a small sample from onboarding). steps: snapshot current model responses, run q4 canary, compute 3 metrics (BLEU-ish, embedding-similarity, manual pass/fail). I can turn this into a 30-min eval runbook.

Oliver Chen: I'll schedule a short enablement session w/ NimbusPay CSM+SRE next Tue 10am PT and include a slide with expected savings and fallback behavior. aim: show quick win before renewal discussion.

Priya Rao: checklist for next week:
- [ ] Marco: publish canary playbook + eval commands
- [ ] Marco: start 5% canary and share perf dash link
- [ ] Oliver: enablement invite to NimbusPay + include renewal-focused metrics
- [ ] Aisha: draft one-slide ROI for renewal packet

redwood-deploy-bot: canary deployment queued (job id: cj-8721).

Priya Rao: thanks team — goal is to prove 10-15% net unit cost reduction with no user-facing regressions. will loop in customer success ops if canary shows improvements. :thumbsup:
